note: Known-bad config values planted live through ForgeTest `config`. They need the G1/G3 services to read these keys at use time (FireService, ToolService, RescueService).

faults.symptom: The hose tank empties after a single spray: water_used jumps to the tank size at once and spraying stops working.
faults.lesson: Compare water_used per spray event with TankSize: one spray emptying the tank is a broken water economy.

faults.symptom: Spraying water at fires has no effect: water_used rises every round while fires_extinguished stays 0.
faults.lesson: If water_used rises but fires_extinguished stays 0, the link between water and fire is broken.

faults.symptom: Fire never spreads: fires_spread is 0 in every round, so only the start fires ever burn.
faults.lesson: fires_spread at 0 across all rounds means fire spread is off, not that players are good.

faults.symptom: Fire spreads so fast it hits the MaxBurning cap within seconds; no round can be won.
faults.lesson: fires_spread far above fires_extinguished in every round, with goal_met false, means spread is overtuned.

faults.symptom: No civilians or pets spawn, so rescued is 0 every round and rescue goals can never be met.
faults.lesson: rescued at 0 in every round, with no carry events, means rescuables are not spawning.
